Notes on typesetting syntax
In Typst you write #set page(width: 1pt) to change the page, #read("data.csv") to load a file and #import
"@preview/cetz:0.3.0" to load a package.
= This line starts with an equals sign Labels look like and references like @intro. Dollar math looks like
$x^2$ and costs $5. A backslash \ and a hash # and braces {} and brackets [] and #{ 1 + 1 } stay literal.
Syntax Meaning
#let x = 1 binding
#emph[hi] emphasis
